items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps your skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps your skin feel comfortably hydrated and supported.
A mineral SPF 50 worn every morning is the simplest long-term habit for keeping skin looking youthful.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then apply sunscreen last each morning and reapply if you're outdoors for long. I left out vitamin C and the firming cream because they aren't needed at 15, and this simple routine gives you the most benefit.
